question: Full research and review of Fitorine (GW0742 / GW610742)

compound.name: Fitorine / GW0742 / GW610742
compound.class: Selective PPARδ/β (NR1C2) agonist — not a SARM

executive_verdict.summary: GW0742 is a potent selective PPARδ agonist (EC50 ~1 nM) that Establishedly drives FAO gene programs in human myotubes and rapid calcineurin-linked cardiac growth plus tumor angiogenesis in rodents (Wagner 2009/2019). No human athletic RCTs; human PK Unknown. Forum Super Cardarine culture (5–20 mg, modal 10 mg) reports acute endurance — Probable soft signal. Not a SARM; not proven safer than Cardarine.
executive_verdict.practical_note: Community dose band 5–20 mg oral, 8–12 wk cycles; prioritize host selection and exposure control for tumor/cardiac nodes; peri-workout carbs for hypo; carnitine Speculative; verify product; Wagner signals are Established rodent, human incidence Unknown.

comparative_alternatives.evidence_quality: Preclinical + forum; abandoned clinical path for 501516
comparative_alternatives.practical_note: Sister compound; stacking both is redundant/risky class exposure

pathway_overlap.point: PPARδ → FAO genes (CPT1, PDK4, UCP3) → endurance/fat oxidation
pathway_overlap.notes: Debard 2006 human myotubes 10 nM; wanted performance pathway
Wagner 2009: angio ~5 h, HW/BW ↑ 24 h; physio-like magnitude but pharmacologic growth risk
Wagner 2019 LLC1: in vivo pro-tumor despite in vitro anti-proliferation
Toral 2015; does not negate tumor-angio signal
Nandhikonda 2013 lab map; gym free-drug relevance Unknown

protective_hypothesis.statement: Host selection + dose/duration control reduce probability mass on tumor-angio and cardiac-growth nodes; peri-workout carbs counter PDK4-biased hypo; carnitine and VitD repletion are pathway-matched Speculative supports for FAO demand and theoretical VDR off-target — none nullify Wagner biology.
protective_hypothesis.literature_summary: No RCTs of protection stacks with GW0742. Wagner 2009/2019 define primary harm pathways from system biology. Seladelpar GI AE profile supports class gut tolerability patterns only loosely.
protective_hypothesis.mechanism_summary: Exposure control hits cumulative PPARδ ligand-time on ECs and myocardium; carbs bypass PDH restraint; carnitine supports CPT1 shuttle; VitD repletion supports VDR axis if μM antagonism ever relevant.
protective_hypothesis.anecdote_summary: AM advises intra carbs on Super Cardarine; cycle 8–12 wk common; cancer/heart discussion tracks literature more than documented cases; seller-adjacent continuous-use safety claims are low-trust.

symptoms: Chest pain, syncope, progressive dyspnea, new edema
New mass, night sweats, unexplained weight loss
stop_criteria: Hard: chest pain/syncope/DOE/edema; GI bleed; new mass/B-symptoms; severe recurring hypo; marked LFT spike; pregnancy
Soft: persistent GI despite form change; no benefit at 10 mg × 2–3 wk verified product; rising BP without other cause

recommendations.statement: Treat community dose band 5–20 mg/day (modal 10 mg) as empirical practice only; titrate 5→10 mg
recommendations.inference_note: No MTD/PD titration; nM EC50 means oral mg can saturate target if bioavailable

recommendations.statement: Limit continuous exposure (e.g. 8–12 weeks on with off periods) given Wagner cardiac and tumor-angio signals
recommendations.inference_note: Exposure shaping Probable as risk reduction logic; not proven detox

recommendations.statement: Do not use if active malignancy, undiagnosed suspicious mass, or high pretest cancer risk without medical clearance
recommendations.inference_note: Host selection is primary counter to P6

recommendations.statement: Control BP; consider echo if family HCM, valve disease, prior mega-AAS, or cardiac symptoms before/during use
recommendations.inference_note: Wagner 2009 mechanism Established rodent; human incidence Unknown

recommendations.statement: Match peri-workout carbohydrates on long/hard sessions to counter PDK4/FAO-biased bonk risk

recommendations.statement: Consider L-carnitine 1–2 g/d or ALCAR 0.5–1.5 g as pathway-matched support for CPT1 shuttle demand

recommendations.statement: Prefer capsules over research liquids; verify COA/HPLC when possible; start low on new bottles
Do not stack with GW501516 or other pro-angiogenic PED piles for 'more effect'
